expectations.text: Notes are factored by CONCEPT, not by source (no 'Make It Stick notes' / 'Ahrens notes' section headers)
expectations.evidence: 11 separate concept notes (retrieval-practice, spacing, interleaving, etc.); MOC groups by theme ('Effective learning techniques', 'Underlying theory') — no per-book/per-author headers anywhere.

expectations.text: Retrieval practice note merges Make It Stick + Karpicke 2011 + Dunlosky under one concept with both/all sources cited
expectations.evidence: retrieval-practice-beats-rereading.md cites 'Sources: Make It Stick (Brown et al.); Karpicke & Blunt 2011 (Science)' with the Karpicke evidence inline; Dunlosky is connected via explicit link to [[study-technique-utility-rankings]] (kept separate because Dunlosky spans multiple techniques) rather than folded in.

expectations.text: Note titles are claim-like statements (e.g. 'retrieval practice beats rereading'), not category labels
expectations.evidence: Titles are claims: 'Retrieval practice beats re-reading', 'Spacing beats massed practice', 'Interleaving beats blocking', 'Elaboration makes learning stick', 'Writing is thinking', 'Evergreen notes compound'; the remainder are established term names (e.g. 'Desirable difficulties'), none are category labels.

expectations.text: Related notes are explicitly linked (wikilinks or equivalent cross-references), incl. generation-effect connection the input flags with 'connects to the karpicke finding?'
expectations.evidence: Every note has a 'See also:' wikilink line; generation-effect.md carries 'Open question (from the original notes): does the generation effect connect to the Karpicke retrieval-practice finding? — see [[retrieval-practice-beats-rereading]]'.

expectations.text: Spacing note preserves the Cepeda 'gap scales with retention interval' claim with attribution
expectations.evidence: spacing-beats-massed-practice.md: 'Evidence: Cepeda et al. (meta-analysis) — the optimal spacing gap scales with the retention interval. "Cram for tomorrow, space for forever."'

expectations.text: Storage strength vs retrieval strength (Bjork) is its own concept note
expectations.evidence: storage-strength-vs-retrieval-strength.md is a standalone note attributed to Bjork, with the '(diff paper?)' uncertainty preserved as a ⚑ flag.

expectations.text: An index/MOC or linked list exists and is consistent with the skill's ~10-note threshold
expectations.evidence: organized.md is an explicit 'Map of Content (MOC)' indexing all 11 concept notes — 11 notes is at/above the ~10-note MOC threshold, so producing one is consistent.

expectations.text: Ends with a counts line whose numbers reconcile (incl. folded/merged source mentions)
expectations.evidence: Counts section: '14 items in → 11 concept notes + this MOC out' with 3 named folds (own-words→elaboration, Karpicke→retrieval, Cepeda→spacing); recount of input confirms 14 items (MIS 4 + Ahrens 3 + 7 singles) and 11 + 3 = 14.
